Q5731.reason: The brother’s interest is measured by the uncle’s life and takes effect only by cutting short the uncle’s estate if the uncle moves, so during the son’s life it is a shifting executory interest pur autre vie.

Q5115.reason: Turning on glycolysis at the start of exercise forms pyruvate faster than mitochondria clear it, so lactate dehydrogenase converts more pyruvate to lactate.

Q5932.reason: Intermittent high-intensity exercise drives catecholamine-stimulated hepatic glucose output above muscle uptake, so blood glucose commonly rises about 1–3 mM over 80–90 minutes.
